# A fresh vault can be created once, inspected, and refuses a wrong passphrase.
! exec azk status
stderr 'not an azk vault'

exec azk init
stdout 'Created vault'

! exec azk init
stderr 'already contains a vault'

exec azk status
stdout 'Format:   v1'
stdout 'Slots:    1'
stdout 'Items:    0'

exec azk --json status
stdout '"format_version": 1'

env AZK_PASSPHRASE=wrong
! exec azk key generate k
stderr 'passphrase does not unlock'

# Passphrase file wins over nothing; env is used when set.
env AZK_PASSPHRASE=
! exec azk key generate k
stderr 'no passphrase'
exec azk --passphrase-file=pass.txt key generate k --type ed25519
stdout 'Kind:     ed25519'

-- pass.txt --
correct horse
